explore-tuner-balun.title: Window line from an unbalanced tuner
explore-tuner-balun.prompt: Stop the window line radiating: add the device that joins unbalanced to balanced.
explore-tuner-balun.success: With a balun at the tuner, the window line carries equal and opposite currents and doesn't radiate.

explore-dipole-balun.title: Coax to a dipole
explore-dipole-balun.prompt: Current is flowing on the outside of the shield. Fix it.
explore-dipole-balun.success: A balun between the coax and the dipole keeps current off the outside of the shield.
